label: Some first mover moved by none is an actual root at w, necessary, first in being and PURE_ACT_5
paraphrase: Same-witness endpoint: one and the same first mover moved by none is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding at w (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground there), exists at every world accessible from w, has no other being SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it and is in POTENCY_1 in no respect. It is the body of the existing necessary-first-being endpoint together with being a first mover. No uniqueness of roots, maximum or God is asserted.
